title: Partner Rental Program Terms: Share of the Rate Owed on Long Rentals in Agency Credits
content:
**Clause on the rate owed.** In auditing an agency payment under Cardinal Rental Reimbursement, the partner program share of the rate the agency should have billed depends on the repair shop and the rental's length. The repair shop is the one that wrote the latest estimate on the Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage claim. The length is the days owed to the agency.

- A rental of **14 or more days owed** on a claim whose latest estimate is from a **Cardinal Select Shop** takes **0.90** (90%).
- A rental of **14 or more days owed** on a claim whose latest estimate is from a **shop outside the Select network** takes **0.97** (97%).
- Any other rental takes the full rate.

The program share is applied once, to the lower of the authorization's recorded daily rate and the option's daily limit. The owed day rate is rounded to the cent.

## Paired boundary cases (hypothetical, recorded rate $60.00 on Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 75/2250, so the lower figure is $60.00)

- Cardinal Select Shop, 13 days owed: owed day rate $60.00.
- Cardinal Select Shop, 14 days owed: $60.00 multiplied by 0.90, which is $54.00.
- Shop outside the Select network, 13 days owed: owed day rate $60.00.
- Shop outside the Select network, 14 days owed: $60.00 multiplied by 0.97, which is $58.20.
